ceramic-coating.title: Nano Ceramic Coating
ceramic-coating.shortDesc: Semi-permanent molecular glass shield delivering jewel-like gloss, hydrophobic self-cleaning, and UV stability.
ceramic-coating.fullDesc: Bonding directly at the microscopic pores of your vehicle's clearcoat, our Nano Ceramic Coating forms a slick, chemically resilient barrier. Water, mud, and road film bead into tight spheres and sheet away effortlessly, maintaining deep reflections wash after wash.

Controlled cross-hatch suede application in dust-managed lighting
Dedicated formulations available for paint, forged wheels, calipers, and glass
ceramic-coating.idealFor: Owners desiring liquid-glass depth, effortless maintenance washes, and long-term chemical resistance.

paint-protection.title: Automotive Paint Protection
paint-protection.shortDesc: Holistic clearcoat preservation combining corrective refinement with warranted hybrid protection architectures.
paint-protection.fullDesc: Our comprehensive Automotive Paint Protection programs combine lifetime-warranted PPF impact coverage (with full OEM paint-safe removal guarantee) and full-body ceramic sealing—preserving factory paint integrity across every panel.
process: Paint surface evaluation under multi-kelvin inspection arches
Targeted correction of swirl marks and clearcoat oxidation
Layered physical and chemical protection backed by our Paint Guarantee
paint-protection.idealFor: Collectors and discerning drivers seeking balanced, end-to-end exterior preservation.

Cabin sanitization, matte leather nourishment, and Alcantara grooming

termsPage.headline: Official Terms, Conditions & Client Warranties
termsPage.intro: These Terms & Conditions govern automotive protection, thermal glazing, nano ceramic, and detailing services provided by INFINITE BRIGHT, operating under Nawader El-Forsan Trading Establishment in the Kingdom of Saudi Arabia.

sections.title: Corporate Identity & Scope of Services
sections.body: INFINITE BRIGHT (Flagship Showroom: Riyadh — Al Murooj District, Imam Saud Road) and its affiliated branches operate under Nawader El-Forsan Trading Establishment, serving the Kingdom of Saudi Arabia for over 15 years as an Authorized 3M Dealer and contracted XPEL partner.

sections.title: Open Lifetime Warranty on Paint Protection Film (PPF)
sections.body: Clients receive an Open Lifetime Warranty on accredited Paint Protection Film (PPF) installations covering material yellowing, cracking, blistering, or delamination under normal care and safe washing practices.

sections.title: 10-Year Warranty on Thermal Insulation & Window Tinting
sections.body: All thermal insulation and automotive window tinting installations—including both Ultra Core (85% heat rejection across all shades) and Core Plus (65% heat rejection)—carry an official Ten (10) Year Warranty against peeling, bubbling, color fading, or loss of solar heat rejection performance.

sections.title: Removal, Re-installation & OEM Factory Paint Guarantee
sections.body: We provide a full Removal & Re-installation Warranty guaranteeing the complete safety of your vehicle's original OEM factory paintwork. When removed at our authorized studio, original factory clearcoat is guaranteed against peeling or adhesive damage.

sections.title: Exclusive 50% Accident Replacement Client Advantage
sections.body: As a dedicated privilege for INFINITE BRIGHT clients, if a vehicle suffers an accident or collision requiring PPF re-installation on any damaged part (such as a bumper, fender, or door), the client pays only 50% of the replacement installation cost for that specific part rather than the full cost, and we cover the remaining 50%.

sections.title: Vehicle Inspection & Official Support
sections.body: Every vehicle undergoes documented pre-service and post-service studio lighting inspection. For warranty service, appointments, or inquiries, contact our unified official line via phone or WhatsApp at +966 53 442 2257.

privacyPage.headline: Privacy Policy & Client Data Protection
privacyPage.intro: INFINITE BRIGHT (Nawader El-Forsan Trading Establishment) respects your privacy and is committed to protecting personal and vehicle information in accordance with applicable regulations in the Kingdom of Saudi Arabia.

sections.title: Information Voluntarily Provided
sections.body: When preparing a consultation request through our website form, you enter your name, mobile number, vehicle model, and preferred service solely to format and initiate a direct WhatsApp conversation with our specialist team.

sections.title: Purpose of Using Client Information
sections.body: Contact and vehicle details shared with us are used exclusively to provide tailored service consultations, schedule studio appointments across our Al Murooj flagship or 3M branches, and register your official Lifetime / 10-Year / Accident warranty records.

sections.title: Strict Confidentiality & Non-Disclosure
sections.body: We never sell, rent, or trade client phone numbers or vehicle details to external marketing agencies or unauthorized third parties under any circumstances.

sections.title: Browser Preferences & Local Storage
sections.body: Our website uses local browser storage (localStorage) strictly to remember your display theme preference (Dark Mode or Light Mode) and language choice (Arabic or English), without invasive advertising trackers.

sections.title: Client Inquiries & Warranty Records
sections.body: Clients may request verification or updates to their registered warranty information at any time by calling or messaging our official customer care number: +966 53 442 2257.
